notes: SHIP v1.14.456 - THE HANDOFF CARD ART STOPS FABRICATING STATUS. WHAT WAS WRONG, and it was a live contract violation rather than a taste problem. icons/HANDOFF-phone@3x.webp baked readable status text into the raster: RACK BUILD Complete, CABLE REPORT Complete, POWER CHECK Complete, INTAKE SYNC Complete, and a READY FOR HANDOFF button. None of that is data PHANTOM has. It is fabricated completion state rendered as if real, on a card the technician taps to reach the actual handoff flow - Contract 10, and it had been shipping behind an owner override of the honesty-lock hold. The replacement carries NO readable text and NO logo, so the override is retired rather than renewed. WHAT ELSE IMPROVED. Substantially darker and emptier left runway, which is what the card layout wants because the .btxt overlay sits there; the cyan and violet lighting language is held; the two-technician tablet exchange is kept as the subject. ⛔ WHAT THIS SHIP DOES NOT CLAIM. The owner's brief also asked for a ticked completion checklist, rack status blocks and a port-map detail on the tablet screen, and for the exchange to read unmistakably as one hand releasing while the other receives. The delivered art has none of the three screen widgets and the grip still reads as two people holding rather than a transfer in motion. It ships anyway because the honesty fix is concrete and live-affecting while the rest is aesthetic refinement that can iterate without a contract violation sitting in production. Recorded so nobody later reads this ship as having satisfied the whole brief. ENCODING, and there is no image tooling on this box. No cwebp, no sharp, no ImageMagick - and none was installed. The source PNG was 2172x724 at 1468 KB, far too heavy for a PRECACHE entry against the 37 KB it replaces. Playwright's Chromium is already present, so the conversion ran through canvas.toDataURL image/webp at q0.86: scaled to cover 1170x403, the intrinsic size dct-ios.html already declares, with the 39px horizontal surplus cropped entirely from the LEFT because a centre crop would have eaten into the receiving hand at the right edge while the left is empty black by design. Result 44 KB. THE FILENAME IS NEW ON PURPOSE. Overwriting a precached asset in place serves the old bytes from cache, so this lands as HANDOFF-phone@3x-v2.webp with both the img src and the PRECACHE entry re-pointed. The previous file stays on disk, orphaned-but-retained per repo precedent. GATES: three-stamp lockstep at .456, inline blocks compile, node --check sw.js, valid JSON, brace balance, 0 bare LF, 0 mojibake. DEVICE-VERIFY: this one needs the PWA removed and re-added on iOS, not just a reload, because the old raster is precached. PASS is the HANDOFF card on the reference surface showing the dark tablet exchange with NO readable words anywhere in the artwork. FAIL is the old art with RACK BUILD Complete still visible, or an empty card with a diagonal hatch, which means the new raster 404d.
